answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 151159 Country: India Title: Can I keep baby boy name just ‘Umar’ or I must have to keep his name ‘Umar Farooq’? Question: Can I keep baby boy name just ‘Umar’ or I must have to keep his name ‘Umar Farooq’? Answer ID: 151159 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 832/766/SD=8/1438) You may keep the name ‘Umar’ only, as well as ‘Umar Farooq’. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
